title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（岡田豪研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Okada Go)
educationalGoal:
Graduation research is done as Design Project III (Project Design III).
1) Understand the fundamentals of chemistry
2) Plan and implement your own experiments
3) Discuss your results and obtain feedback about your next plans
4) Summarize your research achievements as a report and make an oral presentation
advice:
The theme of graduation research (Design Project III) will be selected under the supervision of the instructor.
The seminar meets once a week. During the seminar, you will report the experimental results and discuss your research plan.
requiredKnowledge: A knowledge of laboratory safety is needed. Laboratory experiments should not be performed while alone in the laboratory.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              The theme of graduation research (Design Project III) will be selected under the supervision of the instructor.
The seminar meets once a week. During the seminar, you will report the experimental results and discuss your research plan.
